necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness, raising clinical concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0) and other unspecified cardiac arrhythmias (I49.9). Due to the sporadic nature of these symptoms, continuous rhythm correlation via mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is medically necessary to capture and characterize the underlying arrhythmic events. This extended monitoring is required to establish a definitive diagnosis and guide appropriate treatment management.
